title: Drawing Polygons Practice
description: Practice choosing tools, drawing steps, tolerances, and regular versus irregular polygon checks.

questions.question: Which tools are most useful for drawing a polygon with given side lengths and angle measures?
options: Graph paper and colored pencils only
questions.explanation: A ruler measures and draws side lengths, while a protractor measures and draws angles.

questions.question: A student must draw an octagon. How many sides should the finished polygon have?
questions.explanation: An octagon is a polygon with 8 sides.

questions.question: Which drawing is definitely irregular?
options: A hexagon with all sides 4 cm and all angles equal
A pentagon with all sides 3 cm and all angles equal
An octagon with side lengths 2 cm, 2 cm, 3 cm, 2 cm, 2 cm, 3 cm, 2 cm, 2 cm
A decagon with all sides equal and all angles equal
questions.explanation: The octagon has unequal side lengths, so it cannot be regular. It is irregular.

questions.question: A regular hexagon is drawn using equal exterior turns. What exterior turn should be used at each vertex?
questions.explanation: For a regular hexagon, divide 360 degrees by 6 sides: 360 / 6 = 60 degrees.

questions.question: A polygon can be called regular if all its sides are equal, even when its angles are not equal.
questions.explanation: A regular polygon must have both equal side lengths and equal angle measures.

questions.question: Using the usual classroom tolerance from the lesson, a side meant to be 5 cm should be within how many millimeters of the target length? Write the number only.
questions.explanation: The lesson uses a side-length tolerance of 1 mm unless a teacher gives a different rule.

questions.question: A student draws a regular pentagon using exterior turns. Which angle should be used for each exterior turn?
questions.explanation: For a regular pentagon, divide 360 degrees by 5 sides: 360 / 5 = 72 degrees.

questions.question: A classmate says their drawing is a regular octagon. Name two measurements you should check before agreeing.
questions.correctAnswer: Check that all 8 side lengths are equal and all 8 interior angles are equal.
questions.explanation: Regularity requires both equal sides and equal angles. For an octagon, there should also be exactly 8 sides.
